content: “Necc ssneɣ aqa Cek tzemmared i kuřci war issbeṭṭiř uřa d ijj n wenway nnec.
Cek teqqared: ‘Man wen issbarrcnen břa tussna ccwar n Arebbi?’ S uya ssiwřeɣ x min war fhimeɣ, x tmesřayin nni di ttbehteɣ aṭṭas, war tent ssineɣ.”
“Seř maca uca ad ssiwřeɣ, xseɣ ad Cek sseqsiɣ uca xenni Cek ad ayi xas tessargbed.
S umezzuɣ xak i sřiɣ waha, maca řexxu tiṭṭ inu teẓri Cek.
X uya ttɛiffiɣ ixef inu uca ndemmeɣ, qqimeɣ di tɛejjajt d yiɣɣeḍ.”
Arebbi idebbar x weṣřaḥ d usgenfi

Awarni řami tuɣa issiwiř SIDI awařen-a ak-d Ayub, inna SIDI i Ilifaz zi Tayman: “Lɣaḍab inu yarɣa xak u x tnayen n imeddukkař nnec, maɣar kenniw war xafi tessiwřem ca nican am mammec xafi issiweř umsexxar inu Ayub.

Xenni řexxu, ksim kenniw sebɛa n ifunasen imeẓyanen d sebɛa n icarriyyen, uca uyurem ɣar umsexxar inu Ayub uca qeddmem ten d taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ i yixef nwem. Jjem amsexxar inu Ayub ad xawem iẓẓaǧ. Maɣar Necc ad ssgeɛɛdeɣ aɣembub nnes i westajeb, ḥima war tteggeɣ akidwem am tubbuheřya nwem, minzi kenniw war xafi tessiwiřem nican am mammec xafi issiwiř umsexxar inu Ayub.”
Xenni iffeɣ Ilifaz zi Tayman, Bildad zi Cuḥa d Ṣufar zi Naɛmat uca ggin nitni am mammec d asen inna SIDI. SIDI issgeɛɛed aɣembub n Ayub i ustajeb n tẓaǧit nnes.
Awarni řami tuɣa ittẓaǧa Ayub di ṭṭweɛ n imeddukkař nnes, inneqřeb SIDI tameḥbast n Ayub i di iǧa netta zi ssibbet n řehřac nnes, uca yarni SIDI di marra agřa n Ayub tnayen n tseqqar.

Usin-dd ɣares marra aytmas d marra suyᵉtmas d marra inni t issnen zic. Nitni ccin akides aɣrum di taddart nnes uca ssecnen as aziǧez nsen uca ɛezzan t x marra řɣar xas dd-iɣḍeř SIDI. Iwca as kuř ijjen zzaysen ijj n řewzen n nnuqart uřa d ict n txadent n wureɣ.
Ibarek SIDI taneggarut n Ayub ktar zi tmezwarut nnes, maɣar tuɣa ɣares arebɛa-ařaf n wuǧi d setta-ařaf n iřeɣman d wařef n ifunasen n teɣnact d wařef n teɣyař.
Tuɣa ɣares sebɛa n iḥenjiren d třata n yessis.
Tamezwarut igga as Yamima, wiss tnayen qqaren as Qaṣiɛa d wiss třata qqaren as Qarn-Haffuk.
War ufin di marra tammurt tiḥramin cnant am yessis n Ayub. Babatsent iwca asent tasɣart jar aytmatsent.
Ayub iddar awarni i uya mya u-rebɛin n iseggʷusa. Netta iẓra iḥenjiren nnes d iḥenjiren n iḥenjiren nnes ɣares ař jjiř wiss arebɛa.
Ayub immut awarni řami iwsar aṭṭas u tuɣa ijjiwen ussan n tudart nnes.
